title.en: Explain glycosidic links in sucrose, maltose and lactose

say.en: Same glucose, different jobs. Starch in rice and cellulose in cotton are both made only of glucose. You digest one and not the other. The difference is just the way the glucose units are linked. In this lesson: Describe fructose.
Explain glycosidic links in sucrose, maltose and lactose.
Compare starch, cellulose and glycogen.

body.en: *Fructose* ($C_6H_{12}O_6$) is a ketohexose, D-(−)-fructose, with a five-membered (furanose) ring formed by the C-5 –OH and the C-2 keto group. Two monosaccharides joined through an oxygen atom with loss of water form a glycosidic linkage. Sucrose: α-D-glucose C-1 to β-D-fructose C-2, non-reducing; its hydrolysis inverts the rotation, giving invert sugar. Maltose: two α-D-glucose, C-1 to C-4, reducing. Lactose (milk sugar): β-D-galactose C-1 to β-D-glucose C-4, reducing.
body.kn: ಫ್ರಕ್ಟೋಸ್ ಐದು ಸದಸ್ಯರ ವಲಯವಿರುವ ಕೀಟೋಸ್. ಸುಕ್ರೋಸ್ ಗ್ಲೂಕೋಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಫ್ರಕ್ಟೋಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ಅವುಗಳ ಅಪಕರ್ಷಕ ಕಾರ್ಬನ್‌ಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಜೋಡಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಅಪಕರ್ಷಕವಲ್ಲ. ಮಾಲ್ಟೋಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಲ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೋಸ್ ಅಪಕರ್ಷಕ.

say.en: Maltose gives 2 glucose.
Lactose gives galactose plus glucose.
Fructose is a ketohexose: its carbonyl group is at carbon two. It closes into a five-membered ring.
Sucrose joins alpha-glucose and beta-fructose through carbon one of glucose and carbon two of fructose. Both reducing groups are used, so sucrose is non-reducing.
Hydrolysis gives glucose and fructose. Fructose turns light more strongly to the left, so the sign of rotation flips: invert sugar.

say.en: Maltose and lactose are reducing sugars because one ring can still open.

explanation.en: Sucrose is glucose + fructose (non-reducing, both anomeric carbons used), maltose is two α-glucose units, lactose is β-galactose + β-glucose. Starch, cellulose and glycogen are long chains of glucose.

say.en: Sort each carbohydrate.

body.en: Starch, the plant food store, is amylose (15–20%; water-soluble, unbranched α-D-glucose C1–C4, 200–1000 units) plus amylopectin (80–85%; insoluble, C1–C4 chains branched by C1–C6 links). Cellulose, the main material of plant cell walls, is an unbranched chain of β-D-glucose joined C1–C4. Glycogen, the animal store in liver, muscles and brain, is structurally like amylopectin but more highly branched.
body.kn: ಪಿಷ್ಟ = ಅಮೈಲೋಸ್ + ಶಾಖೆಯುಳ್ಳ ಅಮೈಲೋಪೆಕ್ಟಿನ್, α-ಗ್ಲೂಕೋಸ್‌ನಿಂದ. ಸೆಲ್ಯುಲೋಸ್ β-ಗ್ಲೂಕೋಸ್‌ನ ನೇರ ಸರಪಳಿ. ಗ್ಲೈಕೋಜನ್ (ಪ್ರಾಣಿ ಪಿಷ್ಟ) ಅಮೈಲೋಪೆಕ್ಟಿನ್‌ನಂತೆ, ಆದರೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಶಾಖೆಯುಳ್ಳದ್ದು.

problem.en: Sucrose (+66.5°) is hydrolysed to an equimolar mixture of glucose (+52.5°) and fructose (−92.4°). Estimate the specific rotation of the mixture.

steps.en: Glucose and fructose have the same molar mass, so the mixture contains equal masses of each.

answer.en: About −20°: the sign has changed from + to −, hence “invert sugar”

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Sucrose (+66.5°) is hydrolysed to an equimolar mixture of glucose (+52.5°) and fructose (−92.4°). Estimate the specific rotation of the mixture.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Sucrose plus 66.5 degrees is hydrolysed to an equimolar mixture of glucose plus 52.5 degrees and fructose minus 92.4 degrees. Estimate the specific rotation of the mixture.
Glucose and fructose have the same molar mass, so the mixture contains equal masses of each.
Rotation of mixture is approximately average equals (52.5 plus minus 92.4)/2.
= minus 39.9 over 2 is approximately minus 20 degrees.
So the answer is About minus 20 degrees: the sign has changed from plus to minus, hence "invert sugar".

problem.en: A sample of amylose has a molar mass of 81,000 g/mol. About how many glucose units does it contain? (Each unit in the chain is C₆H₁₀O₅.)

steps.en: Each glucose unit in the chain is C₆H₁₂O₆ − H₂O = C₆H₁₀O₅ = 162 g/mol.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A sample of amylose has a molar mass of 81,000 g/mol. About how many glucose units does it contain? (Each unit in the chain is C₆H₁₀O₅.)

say.en: Let us solve this together. A sample of amylose has a molar mass of 81,000 grams per mole. About how many glucose units does it contain? (Each unit in the chain is C 6H 10O 5.).
Each glucose unit in the chain is C 6H 12O 6 - H 2O equals C 6H 10O 5 equals 162 grams per mole.
Number of units is approximately 81,000 over 162 equals 500.
So the answer is About 500 glucose units.

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಫ್ರಕ್ಟೋಸ್ ಐದು ಸದಸ್ಯರ ವಲಯವಿರುವ ಕೀಟೋಹೆಕ್ಸೋಸ್. ಸುಕ್ರೋಸ್ ಅಪಕರ್ಷಕವಲ್ಲ, ಇನ್‌ವರ್ಟ್ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಮಾಲ್ಟೋಸ್, ಲ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೋಸ್ ಅಪಕರ್ಷಕ. ಪಿಷ್ಟ = ಅಮೈಲೋಸ್ + ಅಮೈಲೋಪೆಕ್ಟಿನ್ (α-ಗ್ಲೂಕೋಸ್); ಸೆಲ್ಯುಲೋಸ್ = β-ಗ್ಲೂಕೋಸ್. ಗ್ಲೈಕೋಜನ್ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ, ಅಮೈಲೋಪೆಕ್ಟಿನ್‌ನಂತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಶಾಖೆಯುಳ್ಳದ್ದು.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. Fructose is a ketohexose with a five-membered ring.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಫ್ರಕ್ಟೋಸ್ ಐದು ಸದಸ್ಯರ ವಲಯವಿರುವ ಕೀಟೋಹೆಕ್ಸೋಸ್.

say.en: Sucrose is non-reducing and gives invert sugar; maltose and lactose are reducing.
say.kn: ಸುಕ್ರೋಸ್ ಅಪಕರ್ಷಕವಲ್ಲ, ಇನ್‌ವರ್ಟ್ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಮಾಲ್ಟೋಸ್, ಲ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೋಸ್ ಅಪಕರ್ಷಕ.

say.en: Starch equals amylose plus amylopectin (alpha -glucose); cellulose equals beta-glucose, unbranched.
say.kn: ಪಿಷ್ಟ equals ಅಮೈಲೋಸ್ plus ಅಮೈಲೋಪೆಕ್ಟಿನ್ (alpha -ಗ್ಲೂಕೋಸ್); ಸೆಲ್ಯುಲೋಸ್ = beta-ಗ್ಲೂಕೋಸ್.

say.en: Glycogen is the animal store, highly branched like amylopectin.
say.kn: ಗ್ಲೈಕೋಜನ್ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ, ಅಮೈಲೋಪೆಕ್ಟಿನ್‌ನಂತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಶಾಖೆಯುಳ್ಳದ್ದು.

say.en: Next: Proteins.
